question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

He was __curious__ to know his result.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Inquisitive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Synonym of '**curious**' is '**inquisitive**'.
 
• **Curious **means eager to know or learn something. (जिज्ञासु)
 
• '**Inquisitive**' means having a strong desire to know or learn something. (कुछ जानने या सीखने की तीव्र इच्छा होना)
 
• It is an adjective and used to describe a person or their behavior.
 
 
• **Example: **She was very inquisitive about the new project and asked many questions.
 
 

Therefore the correct answer is 'Inquisitive'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Ingenious' **means clever or inventive. It is not a synonym of 'curious'.
 
• **'Indifferent' **means having no particular interest or sympathy. It is not a synonym of 'curious'.
 
• **'Indiscriminate'** means done at random or without careful judgment. It is not a synonym of 'curious'.
